prompt: Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: parking lot collision in Baytown, Texas. Injury: back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1335; do not mention it.)
text: I was backing my car out of a parking space at the grocery store on the east side of Baytown, Texas, when I heard a loud bump and felt my vehicle jolt. I had checked my mirrors before reversing, but the other car was approaching from the side aisle faster than I expected. I stopped immediately and got out to look. Both of our cars had damage to the rear bumper area, and the other driver and I exchanged insurance details right there in the lot. Shortly after, I began to feel stiffness and a sharp pain in my lower back, which I believe came from the impact as I braced against the steering wheel. I was evaluated at a local clinic and was told I have a back strain. I am currently following the treatment plan and have limited my lifting until I recover. I am providing this account so the claim can be processed accurately.
